title: Operator silences the ask for this project
asA: operator who does not want to be asked about feedback on this project
iWant: a one-command opt-out that writes rcf/feedback-settings.json:ask false (checked in), and an env variable that silences the ask per user without touching the file
soThat: a shared project silences the ask for everyone, and a CI or per-user preference silences it locally

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback opt-out writes rcf/feedback-settings.json with { settingsVersion: 1, ask: false, redaction: { allowHosts: [] }, quietMinutes: 15 } (merging with any prior file). rcf feedback opt-in restores ask true. The hook shouldAsk returns silent when ask is false. rcf feedback add, preview and submit keep working under ask: false (hand-driven flow).
acceptanceCriteria.when: rcf feedback opt-out then rcf feedback hook stop with one pending entry, then rcf feedback preview
acceptanceCriteria.then: the settings file contains ask: false; the hook exits 0 silently; preview still renders the entry

acceptanceCriteria.description: RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0 forces silent on the hook regardless of file setting. RCF_FEEDBACK_DISABLE=1 makes rcf feedback add a no-op that prints "feedback disabled by env" (no file write, no exit-2). Precedence order: env DISABLE > env ASK=0 > file ask false > file ask true.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with ask true in the file, plus each env variable in turn
acceptanceCriteria.when: rcf feedback add and rcf feedback hook stop are run under each precedence combination
acceptanceCriteria.then: env DISABLE suppresses add entirely; env ASK=0 keeps add working but silences the hook; file ask false silences the hook and add still works

acceptanceCriteria.description: [must-not] Every headless agent session rcf-lite spawns runs with RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0 in its environment (RCF_FEEDBACK_DISABLE is not set by rcf-lite, so rcf feedback add keeps working inside the session), so a project's feedback Stop hook stays silent there and a queued feedback entry can never become the session's final output. Today that session is the verify engine's default launcher (rcf verify run with --url and no --mode deterministic); spawnVerify and the llmJudge eval spawn take the same environment.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project whose .claude/settings.json carries the rcf feedback Stop hook (pinned-bin form) and one pending entry recorded with rcf feedback add --ask-now, and an agent CLI on PATH that runs the project's Stop hook at the end of its turn
acceptanceCriteria.when: rcf verify run --repo <project> --profile local-dev --url <url> --out <file> --fbs <fbs-id> runs in its default agent mode
acceptanceCriteria.then: the agent CLI receives RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0 and no RCF_FEEDBACK_DISABLE; the Stop hook run inside the session exits 0 with empty stderr; the report written to --out carries the agent's findings (verdict is not LAUNCH-FAILURE and no launchFailure); the entry is still listed pending by rcf feedback list --json
